The '''Mark of Dedication''' was an award of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. [[Elin Garza|General Garza]] received it for her actions during the [[Great Galactic War]]. In the aftermath of [[Battle of the Gauntlet]] Garza wanted to award two Marks of Dedication to [[Elara Dorne]] and [[Aric Jorgan]]. The [[Major/Legends|Major]] of [[Havoc Squad]] however, persuaded her to award them two [[Medal of Valor/Legends|Medals of Valor]] instead.
